name: Glitch
summary: A fault in a signal, kept as an image: torn lines, split colour channels and repeated frames.
how: Shift the red and blue channels by 2 to 8px in opposite directions.
Cut bands of 4 to 40px and move them sideways by 10 to 60px.
Run the effect in bursts of 2 to 6 frames at 24 fps, and leave the image clean between bursts.
Do not apply it to body text.

origin.note: Nam June Paik bends the picture of television sets with magnets in his first Exposition of Music-Electronic Television.

adoptions.via: Rosa Menkman writes the Glitch Studies Manifesto; designers copy channel splits and torn bands in posters and sites.
